scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: Efficient, evidence-backed investigation reaching the correct root cause with verified property data. Minor shortfall: it never listed the built projects, only their count, which was part of the explicit ask. One pointless placeholder bash call.

Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → wrong config → output in wrong path
